title: Posted amount bands
prompt: The fraud team reviews posted transactions by size. Write `solve(transactions)` so it returns `transaction_id`, `amount` and a `band` for each posted transaction.
rules: Keep only transactions whose `status` is exactly `posted`.
`band` is `large` for 1000.00 or more, `medium` for 100.00 or more, and `small` below 100.00.
A missing amount gets the band `unknown`.
hints: `filter` the posted rows, then `select` with the new column.
The first true `when` wins, so test the largest band first.
A missing amount fails every comparison, so give `small` its own `when` and leave `otherwise` for `unknown`.
